body:
I tested the cases that previously were broken and they seem to be working now. The editor is no longer blocked (although there might be heavy stuttering while previews are generating, but it does not repeat).

The main problem I see is the usage of `Main::iteration()`. I know we already use it much in the editor, but it would be nice to avoid it if possible xd If not feasible then it's probably fine.

Needs rebase, there are many compilation errors.

I tried testing it again and seems like the new previews aren't working? The scenes use the old previews, at least in 2D. Not sure what went wrong.

I did some testing with single window mode, compatibility renderer etc. and the editor seems to work fine while previews are generated. The previews themselves look good to, except the GUI case I commented above.

Should be good to go once you address the comments, but it's probably too late for 4.7 unfortunately.
